summary: Shelter cabin in 1931 and L-4 cab on the summit in 1933; cab removed or destroyed in 1968; the summit is now a drive-up viewpoint with a campsite below it.

facts.design: Shelter cabin (1931) just west of the summit; L-4 cab on the summit (1933)
facts.status_note: The L-4 cab came down in 1968 (removed or destroyed, depending on the source)

access.note: Willhiteweb describes the summit as a viewpoint and gives drive-up access on gravel roads

visit.trail_note: Gravel roads; some clearance best and good tires; a campsite with a picnic table and fire ring sits in the woods just below the summit

events.note: Shelter cabin built just west of the summit; a 1931 newspaper item reports a look-out house completed at Junior Peak
L-4 cab constructed on the summit
Register says the L-4 cab was removed
firelookout.com and Willhiteweb say the L-4 cab was destroyed
Registered October 21, 2012; nominated by Ray Kresek

corrections.why: No cited page gives a height. The register lists elevation as 6,654 ft (2,028 m), and the other three pages give no height.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says removed in 1968; firelookout.com and Willhiteweb say destroyed in 1968. The story reports both.

sources.title: Junior Point Lookout Site - Chelan District

notes_for_editor: Brief status gone and the 2012 FFLOS registration are confirmed; dates for the 1931 shelter and 1933 L-4 cab agree across sources. Brief height_m 4.3 is not in any cited page; proposed for removal. Brief access unknown is set to public from the Willhiteweb viewpoint description. The 1931 newspaper item is quoted second-hand through the Washington Lookouts page; the original Wenatchee Daily World was not read. The removed-versus-destroyed conflict for 1968 is reported as a conflict.
